description.text:
Overview:
We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge the gap between our data infrastructure and commercial execution. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy and analytics, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize sales performance and omnichannel engagement through actionable insights and rapid strategic analysis. Beyond delivering data solutions, you will champion a data-driven culture by leading data literacy coaching, empowering our frontline sales teams to confidently leverage analytics tools to win in the market.
Key Responsibilities:
• Stakeholder Partnership & Cross-Functional Data Solutions: Partner closely with internal commercial, marketing, and sales leadership to identify business challenges and deliver tailored, data-driven solutions. You will own the business requirements gathering and dashboard design process across key commercial domains, specifically focusing on optimizing sales performance and tracking omnichannel engagement campaigns.
• Commercial Insight Generation: Proactively analyze commercial execution, market trends, and customer touchpoints to produce actionable strategic insights. You will
synthesize findings from various commercial frameworks to help leadership evaluate performance, identify growth opportunities, and make informed decisions that guide overall business strategy.
• Ad-Hoc Strategic Analysis: Serve as the go-to analytical partner for rapid-response, high-impact business inquiries. You will translate ambiguous, emerging commercial needs and market shifts into structured data investigations, providing swift, data-backed recommendations to support agile corporate pivoting.
• Data Coaching & Sales Enablement: Design, implement, and lead comprehensive data coaching initiatives for commercial stakeholders. You will demystify analytics tools, build data comprehension, and drive the seamless adoption of dashboards and reporting workflows into the commercial teams' daily routines.

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Requirements & Qualifications:
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in commercial analytics, business analysis, sales operations, or a commercial excellence function within a high-velocity business environment.
• Analytical & Visualization Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in data visualization tools-specifically Power BI-with a proven track record of designing intuitive, user-friendly
dashboards. Strong fundamental skills in advanced Excel, SQL and Python are required.
• Commercial & Omnichannel Acumen: Deep understanding of commercial growth drivers, sales pipelines, CRM ecosystems, and multi-channel marketing metrics.
• The "Data Translator" Skillset: Exceptional communication and storytelling capabilities. You must possess a proven ability to take complex statistical or technical data outputs and translate them into simple, compelling, and actionable narratives for non-technical commercial audiences.
• Coaching & Facilitation Aptitude: Demonstrated experience or a strong natural aptitude for training, mentoring, and upskilling teams on digital tools, KPI tracking, and analytical concepts.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Business-Administration, Economics; Statistics, Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
